findings.summary: Severity matching is case-sensitive. If the model returns 'High' or 'CRITICAL', the gate exits 2 (error) instead of 1 (changes requested). That still fails closed, but it labels a real review as a gate error. Lower-casing the severity before the check would fix this.
The catch-all handler prints only the exception type name. A failing CI run won't show why it failed. Add str(exc) or print it to stderr to make debugging easier.
The BOM check would treat a UTF-32 LE BOM (ff fe 00 00) as UTF-16. Decoding fails in that case and the gate safely exits 2, so this is only a note.

If the verdict is 'approve' but a finding is high or critical, the gate overrides the verdict and exits 1. That's correct, but the message doesn't say the verdict and findings disagreed. Reporting that would make reviewer inconsistency visible.
